parameters.query: INSERT INTO leads (first_name, last_name, email, email_verified, linkedin_url, phone, job_title, seniority, company_name, company_domain, company_size, company_industry, company_location, company_description, company_linkedin, source, source_query, status, consent_status, opt_out, data_retention_until) VALUES ('{{ $json.first_name }}', '{{ $json.last_name }}', '{{ $json.email }}', {{ $json.email_verified }}, '{{ $json.linkedin_url }}', '{{ $json.phone }}', '{{ $json.job_title }}', '{{ $json.seniority }}', '{{ $json.company_name }}', '{{ $json.company_domain }}', '{{ $json.company_size }}', '{{ $json.company_industry }}', '{{ $json.company_location }}', '{{ $json.company_description }}', '{{ $json.company_linkedin }}', '{{ $json.source }}', '{{ $json.source_query }}', 'new', '{{ $json.consent_status }}', false, '{{ $json.data_retention_until }}') ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING RETURNING id;

nodes.notes: ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING évite les doublons. Remplacez le credential ID.
